// PURPOSE: Allowlist commands Claude can run without prompting
// WILDCARDS: Prefer 'Bash(cargo *)' over 'Bash(cargo build *)' — exact matches don't cover variations (flags, +nightly, env prefixes), so exact lists grow to 200+ one-off Allow clicks. One real Chronos repo went from 253 exact entries to ~48 wildcards with the same coverage.
// NOTE: Merge the relevant sections into a single 'permissions.allow' array for your project. Keep patterns wildcarded per-tool; only narrow one if a specific subcommand is genuinely dangerous (e.g. allow 'Bash(git *)' but rely on hooks to block 'git push --force').
